newsitem.title: USA: Novartis gets UK panel okays on corn hybrid foods.
newsitem.headline: Novartis gets UK panel okays on corn hybrid foods.

text.p: Novartis Seeds Inc, a unit of Novartis Corp said Tuesday two United Kingdom agricultural advisory committees have confirmed the safety of processed food products made from its NK Brand Bt corn hybrids.
Endorsement by the UK is the first step in the European Union procedure to obtain import approval for grain produced from NK Bt hybrids, the company said.

The Advisory Committee on Novel Foods and Processes concluded the products processed from the NK Bt corn were safe for use in food and food made from the grain of NK Bt corn was no different in composition than conventional corn grain products, the company said. The ACNFP noted that normal processing procedures would destroy any material from the insect resistance gene present in the corn grain.
The Food Advisory Committee concluded that special labeling should not be required for products made from grain produced from NK Bt corn hybrids, the company said.
